mapper.select: SELECT member_id, email, password, name, phone, birthday, address, role, status, subscribe_edm, bonus_points, total_orders, total_spent, created_at, updated_at FROM member WHERE email = #{email}

SELECT member_id, email, password, name, phone, birthday, address, role, status, subscribe_edm, bonus_points, total_orders, total_spent, created_at, updated_at FROM member WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1

SELECT member_id, email, password, name, phone, birthday, address, role, status, subscribe_edm, bonus_points, total_orders, total_spent, created_at, updated_at FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (email, password, name, role, status, subscribe_edm, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{role}, #{status}, #{subscribeEdm}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, birthday = #{birthday}, address = #{address}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET password = #{password}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
